notes.title: Bug Fix: Fix occasional crash at start
notes.notes: Fixed an occasional crash when starting the game

notes.title: Explosion Sounds
notes.notes: Added a sound effect to the explosions among some minor bug fixes

notes.title: Add explosions
notes.notes:
In this update, some fun explosions were added. In addition, non-visible changes and refactors were made to improve the game.

[h2]Materials[/h2]
- Added a new sand material: sparkle (for default explosions)
- Removed color variation from blood

[h2]Features[/h2]
- Added explosions, with key press L.
- Added settings for explosions on the left panel

[h2]Other[/h2]
- Changed audio library under the hood, should not cause any visible changes

notes.title: Bloom & Screenshot updates
notes.notes:
A fairly large refactor was done to enable future changes and improvements. But some visible updates.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
- Bloom is now entire screen wide rather than just the canvas
- Bloom settings available in settings
- Image captures also span the entire screen
- Gif captures also span the entire screen (can't resize screen while recording gif)

If you encounter any issues, please contact me on discord! https://discord.gg/3MyPaDagsd

notes.title: New Graphics, UI colors & Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi all, whoever plays my game :).

I'm just learning here, and wanted to update & keep improving the look and feel of the game. I'm trying to make it a bit clearer to you all what this app is. An experience. Art. A toy.

[h2]New trailer & steam page overhaul[/h2]

[previewyoutube=X_O90KyEt8o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Visual Update[/h2]
- New logo,
- New ui colors
- New splash image & default map look

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Clearing will now clear instantly, even if in tracing mode
- Pausing will pause the paths in tracing mode also, so you can explore the visuals better

notes.title: Ice, Water on Wall & Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]MATERIALS[/h2]
Added plain ice and a [i]fun[/i] water on wall sand. Removed empty from default key bindings, so don't forget the quick key [b]E[/b] for that.

[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
Slight Increase in pressure force to push liquid types a bit further apart

[h2]BUGS[/h2]
Fixed default map (new map) not loading graviton image

notes.title: Add Line Draw & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
You can now draw lines & toggle shapes when pressing CTRL (+T). You can also select which shape is being used in the left panel. Use also SHIFT + T to toggle between rectangle and circular shape for the brush. This also changes the line shape!

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
Fixed holes in the ellipse

[h2]OTHER[/h2]
Time was also spent to automate deployment to steam to speed up development time :)

notes.title: New Functions (Add Force), Undo & Redo
notes.notes:
[h3]Features[/h3]
- Add functions to modify (add) forces to cells enabling pushing / pulling materials
- Undo & Redo up to 50 steps when paused (with canvas snapshots)

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
- Fix bug when stepping once when saved in paused mode
- Clear preview image (overlay for shapes & images) when paused
- Fix other smaller bugs

[h3]Other[/h3]
- Reduce steam density (example material)
- Update docs

notes.title: Add Preview Shape & More quick keys
notes.notes:
Now you can preview what you draw with a shape over mouse (Shift)

Also:
- Add quick key to adjust radius & shape thickness (shift + scroll)
- Fix minor bugs

See key [url=https://docs.gravitongame.art/Keys]guide[/url]

notes.title: Customizable Sand
notes.notes:
Graviton has been redesigned to allow full customization of sand materials and to enable more fun play, but also art creation.
- Programmable sand is now possible, with lots of examples
- Better image drag & drop / import
- New UI + key bindings
- Calmer background music
- Gif recording
- Liquids
- Various physics settings
- Much more...

Usage guide found here: https://docs.gravitongame.art/.

Unfortunately though, mac development is on hold due to limitations
